samples.feature: Concurrent registration without changing existing sessions
Parallel dashboard, discovery and every major resource read

Concurrent booking creation, job posting and worker browsing
Booking confirmation, completion and review synchronize
Proposal acceptance creates one shared booking and job completion
Three-way simultaneous chat and unrelated-user privacy
Concurrent household/worker complaints and private history
Concurrent emergency broadcasts, per-worker decline, acceptance and cancellation
Inbox read state and independent installation registration
Role switching, reconnect and logout leave peers authorized

scope: Four independent real API module instances and authenticated Socket.IO sessions, one shared isolated local PostgreSQL database. Native Platform/storage bindings simulated; not four Android phones, rendered native forms, live FCM, live AI, or hosted deployment proof.
